reviews.title: good, long lasting!
reviews.comment: Ok this lasted about 3.5 years of everyday use [often 8h/day] before finally starting to wear out [audio fraying between L and R headphones]. I went ahead and ordered another one from this same seller.
reviews.author: Kelly B.

reviews.title: Don't waste your time unless you're desperate.
reviews.comment: Needed a replacement in a hurry. Couldn't find the OG, so I bought this. It worked for about a day before it started freaking out. If you breathe on the mic switch, it will start creating static in your ears. It also won't last more than a week. If you need to replace the cord on this specific headset. I'd just save your money and replace the whole headset.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Perma mute?!? That's a feature now, not a bug
reviews.comment: I hear wonderfully. The volume works, and the mute is so good it stays on! Yea no one can hear me even with the mute off. Update: they were very gracious and sent out a replacement, works wonderfully! Think I just got an off one.
reviews.author: John M

reviews.title: Worked for something so niche
reviews.comment: So I have a pair of Turtle Beach Elite’s. For the absolute life of me I couldn’t find a replacement cord and I knew my cord was broken. Everywhere I looked, cord’s didn’t look the same. Mine had a regular aux for my controller and a 5 pole for the headset itself. These have been broken for like 2 years at this point. One day I got tired of replacing them and found this. This cord worked and it saved me from throwing out $170 headphones. Sounds perfectly fine. Volume and mute button work. Longer than the original one. Honestly I’m just glad this kind of cord isn’t some random thing only turtle beach made and they no longer sell anymore.
reviews.author: Tayler
